audit.whatIsWrong: Same off-by-one corruption found on aurora. Packet levelChart reads Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Camille, Camille and all seven whys describe exactly that; the stored sides read Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Skill, Warwick, Warwick. Six of seven rows print a side that contradicts the sentence beside it — whys[5] says 'At first item Camille wins' under a row labelled Warwick.
audit.why: The prose and the packet agree with each other and with a 58.41% Warwick win rate over 553 games that decays late; the sides are the corrupted layer.
audit.corrected: All rows set back to the packet chart in both layers as one atomic group, ratings re-keyed. The whys then need no rewrite.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Primal Howl is never named despite being the reason a clean Camille burst fails to kill you.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in the lane. Primal Howl is 15s with 2.5s of damage reduction before the fear; Hookshot is 16s.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl's damage reduction written into early; the 140s ultimate into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter' is wrong — it is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with. 'Chase with W Blood Hunt when she's revealed low' repeats the site-wide fabrication that Blood Hunt reveals; it grants move speed toward and attack speed against sub-50% enemies and no vision.
audit.why: The collision behaviour is what actually decides the Hookshot interaction: she has to leave before the leap starts, not react to it.
audit.corrected: R restated as a collision leap in spikes[1], phases[4].why, mid and breakdown.late; the reveal claim replaced with Blood Hunt's real sub-50% trigger; Precision Protocol and Hookshot named.

edits.before: Your R Infinite Duress hard-suppresses her out of her E hookshot escape and beats her R isolation setup; all-in at 6 when Blood Hunt lights her up below 50%.
edits.after: Infinite Duress collides and suppresses 1.5s, so Hookshot only escapes it if she leaves first; all-in at 6 when Blood Hunt lights her up below 50% health.

edits.before: Chase with W Blood Hunt when she's revealed low
edits.after: Chase with Blood Hunt once she drops under 50%

edits.before: You win the opening lane: Camille's rank-1 Q and single E can't out-trade your Q heal and W attack speed, so walk her down when she steps up to farm and make her burn E defensively.
edits.after: You win the opening lane: Precision Protocol at rank 1 cannot out-trade Jaws of the Beast, and Primal Howl's 2.5s of damage reduction eats her second cast — walk her down and spend her Hookshot.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 are all yours — your sustain beats her pre-item, and at 6 R Infinite Duress suppresses her out of the E hookshot escape she relies on, so all-in whenever Blood Hunt triggers.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 are all yours — Jaws of the Beast beats her pre-item, and at 6 Infinite Duress collides and suppresses through the Hookshot escape, so all-in whenever Blood Hunt triggers.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Camille's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it hits. The Hextech Ultimatum is 140s — fight her while it is spent.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Camille carry threat: 9/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with — build the fight around it. Camille carry threat: 9/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Q-bite Camille as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Camille as she steps up (hold Q to follow her Hookshot), weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger heal you under 50%.

notes: Second confirmed instance of the off-by-one level chart (aurora was the first): the stored sides are shifted one row against both the packet chart and the entry's own whys. If this is a systematic corruption across warwick, a sweep comparing packet levelChart to win[]/phases[].side for every matchup would find the rest cheaply. Also removed another 'Blood Hunt reveals' fabrication and the point-and-click description of Infinite Duress.
